name: Southwest Tennessee Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Non-resident full-time (12 credit hrs) tuition & fees = $4,294/semester ($4,104 tuition + $135 tech + $43 other) x 2 = $8,588/yr. Source: official Bursar's Office tuition page (southwest.tn.edu/financial-and-administrative-services/bursars-office/tuition.php), Fall 2026 (2026-27 academic year). In-state equivalent ~$5,084/yr, consistent with provided in-state figure of $5,217.
